pages.title: Pentaquark Shard
pages.text: Four quarks and an antiquark, bound into one hadron that real accelerators only glimpse as a bump in a decay spectrum. Here the bump has been frozen into a glittering shard. It hums faintly against the palm, as if the five constituents are still arguing over who holds whom, and the colour charge never quite settles.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Smashing strange matter into antimatter inside the Hyperion Synchrotron, I saw a resonance in the debris that matched no ordinary baryon. Pouring quark-gluon plasma over the collision point, then cooling it with entangled photons, let the five-quark state crystallise before it fell apart.
